title: VoxAngeles: Phonetic Segmentation of the UCLA Phonetics Lab Archive
data_type: secondary recordings with genuinely new isolatable manual phonetic annotations and derived measurements
manual_annotation_evidence: Phone alignments initialized automatically, then manually adjusted and audited by phonetically trained annotators; audited_aligned is explicitly separated upstream from unaudited forced alignments
measurement_domains: phone and word intervals; phone and word duration; vowel F0 trajectories/summaries; vowel formant trajectories/summaries; audited phonetic transcription
lineage_rule: Underlying UCLA/CMU recordings are not a new recording lineage. Admit only VoxAngeles newly audited/corrected annotation layers and measurements derived from those audited intervals; exclude data/unaudited from core.
notes: Current audited release spans 95 languages in 21 families. Preserve original/adapted transcription and interval timing. Repository measurement tables are public and separately manifested.
